summary: John's 6th-great-grandmother, missing from his tree; wife of Andreas Grub, who remarried in Pennsylvania.
bio:
Maria Elisabetha Christmann was born 9 Aug 1729 at Kollweiler, daughter of the late Jacob Christmann, and married Johann Andreas Grub at Jettenbach on 19 Sep 1752. She emigrated with him in 1754. Widowed in 1792, she was co-executor with son Frederick, and later married widower Christopher Bittenbender. Her 1810 will names 'her son Frederick Krub'. She died 19 Jan 1815 and was buried at Easton Cemetery (Find a Grave 261051335). Not in John's tree (Round 1 correction 3h: add her).

Her baptism is now read in the original Reichenbach Lutheran register (page 115, 1729): under 9 August, Jacob Christmann of Kollweiler and his wife Anna Margaretha had a daughter born, baptized on the 14th (9th Sunday after Trinity), and named Maria Elisabetha; the godparents included a Conrad ... of Nanzweiler and a Maria Elisabetha ([R4-S1]). This confirms the 9 August 1729 birth and gives her mother's first name, Anna Margaretha. FamilySearch calls the mother 'Anna Margarethe Raab' and gives the parents' marriage as 24 Nov 1722 at Kollweiler ([R4-S2]); the surname Raab is not in the baptism entry and is unverified.
